top: In 1932, Australia sent soldiers with machine guns to fight an enemy in Western Australia. The soldiers lost.
comment: The enemy was about 20,000 emus eating the wheat farms. After weeks of shooting, the army pulled out and the emus barely noticed. It's called the Great Emu War.
topic_it: La 'Grande guerra degli emù' (Australia Occidentale, novembre-dicembre 1932): soldati con mitragliatrici Lewis contro circa 20.000 emù, operazione fallita
photo_it: Foto storica di un soldato con un emù durante la Emu War (Wikimedia Commons, pubblico dominio) + un emù (National Geographic)
title: They sent soldiers to fight Emus and lost #history #fail #didyouknow
description:
In 1932, Australian soldiers with machine guns were sent against about 20,000 emus in Western Australia, and the emus won the Great Emu War.
